modules.title: Sensors & Transducers in Machine Tools & Robots
modules.topics: Sensors & Transducers in Machine Tools & Robots: Mechatronics revolutionizes industries by seamlessly blending mechanical and electronic components, enhancing efficiency and adaptability. Sensors, acting as sensory organs, enable machines to perceive and respond to their environment, ensuring safety and functionality across diverse applications. From proximity to temperature sensors, these devices are pivotal for accurate and reliable operations in modern manufacturing. Servo Systems in Machine tools & Robots: Optical encoders ensure precise speed measurement in machine tools by converting shaft rotation into digital signals, vital for CNC machining and robotics. Sensor interfacing in CNC machines enables predictive maintenance, optimizing tool usage and enhancing machining efficiency. Autonomous mechatronic systems in machine tools operate independently, adapting to dynamic conditions, reducing human intervention, and optimizing processes.

modules.title: Interfacing and Simulation
modules.topics: Interfacing and Simulation: Industrial robots are meticulously designed for precision and efficiency, featuring structured systems with carefully arranged components like joints and links. These versatile robot manipulators excel in tasks ranging from manufacturing to surgery, offering precision and flexibility in complex environments. Tailored robotic configurations, along with specialized gripper designs, optimize efficiency across various applications, while microprocessors and PLCs orchestrate seamless control and automation in modern machinery.

modules.title: Robotic Engineering Essentials
modules.topics: Robotic Engineering Essentials: Robotic Engineering and Automation integrate mechanical, electrical, and computer engineering to develop intelligent systems, enhancing efficiency and safety in industries. Industrial robots, equipped with programmable control systems, perform tasks with precision and consistency, organized with meticulous arrangement of components for optimal performance and adaptability. Understanding robotic configurations, kinematics, and dynamics guides the selection and design process, ensuring effective task execution and spatial manipulation capabilities. Robot Programming and Vision System: Robot programming methods, including teach pendant, offline simulation, and script-based programming, offer flexibility and efficiency in task deployment, involving motion path definition and end-effector configuration. Evolution in programming techniques, supported by standardized languages like ROS and RAPID, ensures seamless integration and adaptability, illustrated through collaborative Robot programming and practical vision system applications for enhanced perception and decision-making in diverse industries.

modules.title: PCC-PEC-OEC (3 Credits)template 2 Robot Building and Applications
modules.topics: PCC-PEC-OEC (3 Credits)template 2 Robot Building and Applications: Robot design involves meticulous consideration of criteria such as payload capacity, reach, speed, and precision, with iterative testing and optimization ensuring efficiency and reliability. End effectors, critical for functionality, must align with task requirements and the robot's capabilities, emphasizing adaptability and specific application needs. Integration of IoT enhances connectivity and data exchange, optimizing decision-making processes and promoting efficiency in robotic applications.

modules.title: Industrial Fluid systems & Smart Factory Automation
modules.topics: Industrial Fluid systems & Smart Factory Automation: Fluid and Electrical Drive Systems: Explore the essence of fluid power in modern machinery, emphasizing hydraulic and pneumatic actuators' pivotal role. Delve into hydraulic pumps, actuators, and pneumatic systems, showcasing their application diversity and efficiency in heavy-duty and precision tasks within machine tools. Fluid circuit Systems: Discover the intricacies of pneumatic and hydraulic circuits, from their essential components to their roles in sequential and simultaneous operations. Smart Factory Automation: Explore the transformative potential of Smart Factories, leveraging IoT, AI, and robotics to optimize production, enhance energy efficiency, and facilitate predictive maintenance.

outcomes: Understand various sensors, transducer and servos for robots.
Understand how to interface and simulate robot.
Describe the configurations, kinematics and dynamics of robot.
Build the robot and understand their applications.
Know about various fluid systems and smart factory automation..

Binary Search Tree (BST): Implement a BST to efficiently store and search for data in a sorted manner, such as maintaining a dictionary of words or a database of records.
